newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs, pork bellies seen higher on pork demand.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs, pork bellies seen higher on pork demand.

text.p: CME lean hog futures were expected to open 0.100 to 0.200 cent per lb higher while pork belly futures were called 0.250 to 0.500 cent higher, livestock analysts said.

Further strength in hog futures is expected to stem from steady to higher cash hog indications and stronger-than-expected cash pork prices. Possibly good domestic and export demand for pork has boosted pork prices which should keep packer demand strong for the light hog supplies, analysts said.
Pork cutout values rose $1.43 to $1.44 per cwt Wednesday as most items showed advances in USDA reports.
